The '''Golden Ravine''' was the last part of the [[Baroo Coast/Legends|Baroo Coast]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]. The rock formation featured curving mesa roads and winding turns.
